observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher breaks down soukous dance mechanics using clear visual demonstrations and onscreen text instructions. She maintains an encouraging, step-by-step approach focusing on body isolation and posture.

lesson_structure.note: Teacher waves and introduces the soukous tilt tutorial
Step-by-step instructions on stance, knee bending, and hip movement
Shows the movement from a side view angle
Shows the movement from a back view angle
Counts out loud from 1 to 8 while demonstrating
Encourages the viewer to try and says goodbye

metaphors: the motion is like a seesaw
common_mistakes: upper body moving instead of staying still

steps_taught.name: soukous tilt
steps_taught.description: Bending alternate knees to lift and tilt the opposite hip like a seesaw while keeping the upper body still.

what_works: demonstrations from front, side, and back angles
what_hinders: no background music used during practice

quotes.text: the motion is like a seesaw

evidence_segments.observation: Teacher stands facing the front with feet apart and demonstrates knee bending with text overlay.
Teacher turns to the side profile to demonstrate hip tilt and knee action.
Teacher turns to face backward to show the rear movement of the hips.

extraction.distinctive_method: Using explicit angle changes (front, side, and back) paired with descriptive text overlays to explain body mechanics.
